definitions.explanation: Lacking refinement or good taste; coarse in manner or speech.

examples.japanese: そんな{下品|げひん}な{言葉|ことば}を{使|つか}わないでください。
examples.english: Please don't use such vulgar words.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{冗談|じょうだん}はいつも{下品|げひん}だ。
{大声|おおごえ}で{笑|わら}うのは{下品|げひん}だと{思|おも}われることもある。
examples.english: Laughing loudly is sometimes considered vulgar.

notes:
{下品|げひん} describes something vulgar or lacking in refinement. It can describe speech, behavior, appearance, or taste.

Forms:
- {下品|げひん}な + noun: {下品|げひん}な{言葉|ことば} (vulgar words)
- {下品|げひん}に + verb: {下品|げひん}に{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う (to behave vulgarly)

Antonym: {上品|じょうひん} (elegant, refined)

Similar words:
- {卑|いや}しい - base, low, mean (stronger negative connotation)
- {粗野|そや} - rough, uncouth
- {品|ひん}がない - lacking class/refinement
